\textit{Note.} Drift = the EFFECTIVE metric (last fix $\rightarrow$ first returning fix); the end-of-loss metric differs by $\le$ 5 mm (unrounded 5.1 mm). Pre-registered drift bands (H5.5): EKF3 and FGO $\le$ 50 / 100 / 200 / 150 mm, UKF $\le$ 100 / 200 / 400 / 300 mm. H5.5 (drift band) and H5.7 (no lockout) PASS. The comparative hypotheses (H5.2, H5.3, H5.4a--b) are reported on these final-build sets (primary); their verdicts are identical to the original-build verdicts (all FAIL). Each estimator flew its own flights: pairing by run index, not trajectory.\par
\textit{Note.} EKF3 = the EKF3-flying hold set at the near spawn (3 flights) and at the far spawn (3 flights). UKF = the final UKF port (jitter-corrected); FGO = the final FGO node (C++, flown with the original FGO priors).\par
\textit{Note.} The drift bands (H5.5) and the lockout criterion (H5.7) are per-estimator criteria, not comparisons (the UKF's bands are twice the others'); their n is the number of tag losses (one of each kind per flight).\par
\textit{Note.} Ordering verdicts used in the footnotes: RULE MET = a pre-registered rule was applied and met, so its ordering (or similarity) is claimed; case (i) TEST RUN, RULE NOT MET = a pre-registered decision rule with a 'no ordering' outcome was applied and gave that outcome; case (ii) FAILED AS WORDED = a pre-registered prediction of an ordering or a similarity was scored literally and is false, which does not by itself establish the opposite ordering; case (iii) NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED = values are descriptive. n always names its unit (flights, bags, losses).\par
\textit{Note.} [a] Ordering basis, Experiment 5 comparative hypotheses, final-build sets (H5.2, H5.3, H5.4a, H5.4b). Metric: H5.2 mean hold error, mm; H5.3 hold gyro activity, max $\div$ min across the estimators; H5.4a/b re-lock jump after the 15 s / 5 s tag loss, mm. n = 3 flights per estimator (each estimator flew its own 3 flights, paired by run index, not trajectory; EKF3 = the EKF3-flying hold set at the far spawn). Rule: H5.2 'FGO $<$ EKF3 and FGO $<$ UKF mean hold error in 3/3 flights'; H5.3 'gyro activity \ldots{} within 1.5$\times$ across estimators'; H5.4a after the 15 s loss 'EKF3's re-lock jump \ldots{} is larger than the UKF's and the FGO's in 3/3 flights'; H5.4b after the 5 s loss 'the jumps are within 1.5$\times$ of each other' (design \S{}e, tag\_hold\_design.md:180, tag\_hold\_design.md:183, tag\_hold\_design.md:185, tag\_hold\_design.md:186, tag\_hold\_design.md:187; these have no METHODOLOGY pre-registration line; verdicts METHODOLOGY.md:12236, METHODOLOGY.md:13549). Result: FGO lowest in 0 of 3 flights (hold UKF 6.4--7.1, EKF3 7.8--7.9, FGO 8.3--8.6 mm; UKF lowest in 3 of 3); H5.3 max $\div$ min 2.40--2.58; H5.4a EKF3's 15 s jump 5 / 5 / 7 mm, the smallest; H5.4b max $\div$ min 3.2--7.7: all four FAIL. Verdict: case (ii), FAILED AS WORDED: the registered prediction is false as written; a failed criterion does not by itself establish an ordering, so any ordering shown is descriptive.\par
